closed_findings.finding: The first disabled-Kerr and disabled-coupler controls applied the full inverse to an altered forward law.
closed_findings.repair: The disable flags now propagate through inverse_layer, each altered path applies its matching lawful inverse, and both restoration errors are hard-gated.

mechanism_assessment.forward_law: Kerr intensity phase update followed by two disjoint SU(2) couplers.
mechanism_assessment.inverse_law: Reverse pair adjoints restore the post-Kerr cells; inverse Kerr then uses the restored intensities, which Kerr itself did not change.
mechanism_assessment.amplitude_custody: Amplitude remains in four ordinary complex working cells. There is no phasor-pair split, amplitude chart, or gauge canonicalization.
mechanism_assessment.fixed_rank_meaning: Fixed carrier dimension only, not fixed relational rank, tensor rank, or computational complexity.
mechanism_assessment.resource_caveat: The 64-byte live-carrier label counts the four complex carrier components, not total struct, stack, code, counters, or process memory.

reference_scope.depth2048: Deterministic replay, sanitizer, norm conservation, and inverse restoration only; no cross-implementation parity.
